about.heading: 20+ Years of Electrical Field Expertise
about.sub: A workforce your operations can rely on, every single day.
about.text1: MANISH ELECTRICALS was established in 2001 and has since built a trusted reputation for electrical labour supply and field workforce support in Surat, Gujarat.
about.text2: Today we field a professional team of more than 90 employees serving Torrent Power Ltd and local customers with safety, discipline and quality.

cta.heading: Need Reliable Electrical Manpower?
cta.sub: Speak with us about your workforce requirements — we respond quickly.

about.heading: About Us
about.desc: A disciplined electrical workforce partner based in Surat, Gujarat.
about.story1: MANISH ELECTRICALS was established in 2001 and has more than 20 years of experience in electrical labour supply and field workforce support.
about.story2: The company provides labour supply and field workforce services to Torrent Power Ltd and local customers in Surat.
about.story3: Our workforce is our strength. More than 90 employees operate under clear supervision, daily reporting and a strong safety culture — ensuring every client gets consistent, accountable field support.
about.focusSub: These principles guide how we work every day.
about.reliabilityDesc: Dependable workforce availability for scheduled and urgent requirements.
about.professionalWorkforceDesc: Well-managed employees who carry out field work with discipline.
about.safetyDesc: PPE awareness, safety awareness and supervised work at all sites.
about.qualityDesc: Quality workmanship with proper attention to every task.
about.disciplineDesc: On-time attendance, structured reporting and responsible conduct.
about.timelyDesc: Work delivered within committed time frames.
about.fieldSupportDesc: Direct field supervision and responsive on-ground support.

services.heading: Our Services
services.desc: Complete electrical manpower and field workforce solutions for utility, industrial and local clients in Surat.
services.s1Desc: Reliable, trained electrical workers supplied to meet your daily, weekly or project-based requirements with consistent availability.
services.s2Desc: Complete field teams for utility operations — supervised, disciplined and ready to mobilise at short notice.
services.s3Desc: Skilled manpower for scheduled and corrective maintenance of electrical systems and field assets.
services.s4Desc: Field support for meter related tasks including reading, installation assistance, checks and reporting.
services.s5Desc: Workforce assistance for electrical installations, connections and commissioning activities.
services.s6Desc: End-to-end management of site manpower — attendance, reporting, supervision and performance discipline.
services.s7Desc: Technical personnel support for skilled field activities requiring training and experience.
services.s8Desc: Dependable manpower for day-to-day field operations with clear task tracking and daily reports.
services.howHeading: What You Get With Our Workforce
services.how2: Daily work reports and attendance tracking
services.how4: Mobile, easy-to-contact single point of contact

safety.heading: Safety & Quality
safety.desc: Safety and quality are not slogans — they are how we work every day.
safety.workplaceSafetyDesc: Safe work practices are followed across all sites with clear supervision.
safety.ppeDesc: Employees are trained and encouraged to use proper personal protective equipment.
safety.disciplineDesc: Punctuality, conduct and reporting discipline are maintained at every level.
safety.supervisionDesc: Supervisors guide field teams to ensure work is done correctly and safely.
safety.qualityControlDesc: Work is checked against client requirements with attention to detail.
safety.timelyReportingDesc: Daily work reports are submitted and reviewed to keep operations transparent.
safety.complianceDesc: We follow client safety guidelines and site compliance requirements.
safety.commitmentText: We do not claim certifications we do not hold. Our commitment is practical: trained supervision, daily reporting, PPE awareness and disciplined field employees — every single day.
